statement: Transferring a fascicle of the ulnar nerve to the biceps motor branch restored elbow flexion in patients with C5-C6 root avulsion, where repair at the level of the injury was not possible.

context.intervention: ulnar fascicle to musculocutaneous biceps branch transfer

replication.note: The original series was small; the transfer has since been reproduced widely and is standard practice, though those series are not cited here.

limitations: four patients in the original report
restores one movement, not the hand

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
